set.body:
Scope: modules/surface, atlas, spatial and mesh-dependent test fixtures.

Deliverable: Migrate downstream geometry consumers and delete replaced mesh/domain helpers after preserving their meaningful assertions.

Acceptance:
- Surface, atlas and spatial portable suites pass on JVM and JS with exact index/field correspondence.
- GIFTI/FreeSurfer/Workbench projection and transform fixtures preserve their results and existing caveats.
- Renderer preparation retains buffer/order/allocation contracts; old geometry authorities have no remaining callers.

Apply the shared migration and verification requirements in eco-unification.
set.title: U3: Cut surface, atlas and spatial callers over to native meshes
